response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but he falls short of core requirements for this executive leadership role. His German is self-reported as 'Basic' against a hard C1 minimum, his career has been almost entirely individual-contributor roles with no formal team leadership or client-facing consulting management, and there is no evidence of UML, formal requirements management, or IT security/compliance expertise. These gaps outweigh his impressive technical depth for this particular position.
strengths: Nearly 20 years of hands-on development across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems
Genuine open-source commitment: founder/maintainer of GISCollective and multiple D-language libraries, strong Linux background
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentoring through conference talks, workshops, and courses
concerns: German at 'Basic' level, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal experience leading teams, managing projects, or overseeing client engagements at an operational/executive level
No evidence of UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/risk/compliance work; Python absent from skill set

key_factors.factor: Deep open-source and Linux engineering experience
